inputs: No reference images. New generation from text descriptions.

prompts.title: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: an original Japanese mahjong game title graphic on a genuinely transparent background. Text must be EXACTLY these TWO Japanese kanji arranged in one vertical column: top character 麻, bottom character 雀. Read vertically as 麻雀. No other text at all. Create an original hand-brushed calligraphic composition, confident bold thick strokes with natural thin-to-thick variation, crisp energetic brush ends, restrained dry-brush detail, elegant compact silhouette. Ink color: warm pale ivory with subtle muted gold depth, high contrast on a deep green felt background (but do NOT draw the background). The two characters should have balanced weight and be very legible at about 220 pixels tall total, not overly abstract or distorted. Upright portrait composition, approximate width:height 299:442, full strokes visible, generous transparent padding. No seal, no red mark, no tile illustration, no border, no shadow, no symbols beyond 麻雀, no watermark. This must be a fresh generic title, do not copy any existing game logo or brush lettering. The output is an isolated title graphic with full transparency.
prompts.background: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original background texture for a realistic Japanese mahjong game, aspect ratio 4:3. A clean high-quality deep jade green mahjong table felt seen from directly overhead, completely planar and filling the entire image edge to edge. Fine short velvet-like felt fibers and very subtle woven microtexture, soft diffuse studio illumination, a gentle broad brightening near the center and restrained darker corners. Color centered around medium-deep green #32684f, comfortable contrast behind white mahjong tiles, yellow scores and ivory title lettering. Quiet low-contrast natural textile surface, realistic material rather than a synthetic gradient. No objects, NO tiles, NO dice, NO text, NO lines, NO symbols, NO logos, NO table rim, NO wooden border, NO perspective, NO seams, NO large visible patterns, no watermark. Create the texture from scratch; do not reproduce any existing game backdrop.
prompts.seal: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original small Japanese red seal emblem for a mahjong game's title screen, genuinely transparent background. A single compact roughly square vermilion-red hanko imprint with a thin subtly irregular square outer border. Inside, one white/transparent hand-carved seal-style Japanese character EXACTLY 和, highly recognizable, balanced and bold. The white areas should be genuinely transparent negative space, not a white square background. Sophisticated restrained handmade stamp texture, slightly worn corners but clear small-scale silhouette. Flat red ink imprint, no 3D object, no paper, no shadow, no other characters, no decorative illustrations, no watermark. Entire mark fully visible with generous transparent padding. Must remain readable at 52 by 52 pixels. New generic custom seal; do not copy any real person's seal, brand or signature.
